question: What exact workflow or decision does this AI pilot support?
evidence_to_attach: One-page brief; user journey; excluded decisions
stop_or_escalate_signal: Scope says all operations fully autonomous or regulated advice without controls

question: Who uses the output and who can override it?
evidence_to_attach: Role map; approval path; override log
stop_or_escalate_signal: No named human fallback or unclear accountability

question: Which customer employee financial or sensitive data touches the workflow?
evidence_to_attach: Data inventory; vendor-processing notes; retention answer
stop_or_escalate_signal: Unknown sensitive data retention region or subprocessor treatment

question: How was output quality checked before expansion?
evidence_to_attach: Test set; failure categories; retest cadence; sampled approvals
stop_or_escalate_signal: No baseline no red-team examples or no regression plan

question: What unit-cost LLM GPU cloud and support-load thresholds trigger review?
evidence_to_attach: Spend estimate; alert owner; volume scenario; approval gate
stop_or_escalate_signal: Costs can scale without approval or owner visibility

question: What access secrets logs model/vendor and integration risks need review?
evidence_to_attach: Access list; environment boundary; vendor answers; incident contact
stop_or_escalate_signal: Production access without review or unclear incident ownership

question: How is the AI path paused reversed or replaced if quality cost or risk changes?
evidence_to_attach: Rollback checklist; manual fallback; rehearsal evidence
stop_or_escalate_signal: No pause trigger fallback or recovery owner

question: What can be safely said publicly in sales to investors or to customers?
evidence_to_attach: Approved claim log; proof links; adviser review notes
stop_or_escalate_signal: Claims of accuracy safety compliance savings or transformation without approved proof
